s: Today we talk about food and kitchen words.
You buy bread in a shop.
In the morning, I eat bread with cheese.
I eat bread and cheese every morning.
An egg comes from a chicken.
You cook it in the morning.
I eat two eggs for breakfast.
Boiled eggs, or eggs in a hot pan.
Tell me, Maya, what do you drink for breakfast?
It is good for your body.
I drink milk with my breakfast.
An apple is a round red or green fruit.
An apple a day keeps the doctor away!
That means: eat fruit, stay healthy.
I eat an apple every day.
A banana is long and yellow.
You open the skin and eat the soft fruit inside.
Monkeys love bananas, and I love them too!
I eat a banana after lunch.
Easy to carry, easy to eat.
An orange is a round orange fruit.
You can eat it or drink orange juice.
I drink orange juice every morning.
Maya, what do you eat for lunch?
Many people in the world eat rice every day.
Rice with an egg is nice too!
You can eat rice with a spoon.
Speaking of spoons, let's talk about kitchen tools now.
A spoon is a small tool.
You eat soup with a spoon.
You eat rice with a spoon.
A spoon is round and safe.
You cut bread with a knife.
A knife is not for small children.
Yes, be careful with a knife.
A fork has four small points.
You eat food with a fork.
You pick up food with a fork.
So we have three kitchen tools: spoon, knife, and fork.
Knife for cutting bread and cheese.
Water is very important for life.
So let's remember all twelve words.
Food words: bread, cheese, egg, milk, apple, banana, orange, rice.
Say them with me: bread, cheese, egg, milk, apple, banana, orange, rice, spoon, knife, fork, water.
Now you know twelve food and kitchen words.
Make breakfast with bread, egg, and milk.
Eat an apple and a banana.
Cut the bread with a knife.
Eat with a spoon and fork.
I will make breakfast right now!
And a glass of orange juice.
Thanks for listening to Word Kitchen.
Eat well, drink water, and stay healthy!
